meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会先搜索相关文档和示例，然后制定一个分阶段的实施计划。每个阶段都包含具体任务、文档引用和验证清单，最后还会检查是否遵循了文档。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步骤实施时触发，尤其是在执行具体操作之前。

say.text: 帮我规划一个用户登录功能的实现计划。
say.note: Claude 会先查找相关文档，然后输出分阶段计划。

say.text: 为这个新API写一个实施计划，分阶段进行。
say.note: Claude 会搜索API文档，然后制定计划。

howto.what_en: Claude will first search relevant docs and examples, then create a phased implementation plan. Each phase includes specific tasks, doc references, and verification checklists. Finally, it checks adherence to documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan the implementation of a user login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will search docs and output a phased plan.

say_en.text: Create an implementation plan for this new API, phase by phase.
say_en.note: Claude will search API docs and create a plan.
